Workload_Assumptions.Target_Workload: Enterprise Multi-Session Advisory Agent & 10,000-Document Contract Corpus (1.2M Queries/Month, 30-Turn User Sessions)

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Full-History 64K/128K Context Stuffing on Every Turn (Zero Memory Extraction)
Configuration_Matrix.Memory_And_RAG_Engine: Append Entire Raw Transcript + Raw Docs into Prompt on Every Turn
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Anti-pattern for >10-turn sessions: quadratic attention cost and Lost-in-the-Middle temporal confusion

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Standard Chunk-Only Vector RAG (Top-5 Cosine Chunks for Both Docs & Chat History)
Configuration_Matrix.Memory_And_RAG_Engine: 512-Token Chunk Embedding Search (No Entity Graph or Temporal State Tracking)
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Simple single-fact lookup; fails global corpus sensemaking and contradicts outdated user preferences

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Heavy Community-Hierarchy GraphRAG Map-Reduce on 100% of Queries
Configuration_Matrix.Memory_And_RAG_Engine: LLM-Extracted Leiden Communities + Global Map-Reduce Over All Community Summaries
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: High-value offline intelligence reports, but too slow (3.45s) and expensive for real-time chat turns

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Query-Routed Hybrid Architecture: `Mem0/Zep` Bi-Temporal User Memory + `Vector/BM25` (Local) + `LightRAG` Entity-Edge Graph (Global)
Configuration_Matrix.Memory_And_RAG_Engine: Async Background Memory Consolidation (`Mem0/Zep`) + Incremental Dual-Level `LightRAG` + Query Router
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Production standard for enterprise Agents (91.5% multi-hop/temporal accuracy, 265ms P95, and -82% TCO vs stuffing)
